token.description: Full bearer token (admins only). Use it as `/bot<token>/<method>` or `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

avatar.description: The picture of a channel or group DM that everyone sees (an attachment id with purpose `avatar`).

last_seq.description: Highest message sequence number in this conversation.

before_ms.description: Delete everything strictly before this time (in `conv_id`).

message_ids.description: Specific messages; or leave empty and use `conv_id` plus a date range.

AdminUpdates.description: The admin panel's "Updates" card: this server's version against the newest GitHub release.

checked_ms.description: When the server last asked GitHub (ms since the epoch).

error.description: Why the check failed (offline, rate limit...), shown instead of the release.

latest.description: The newest published release (drafts and pre-releases skipped), even when it is not newer.

release_url.description: The GitHub "latest release" page (the configured `release_url`), always shown as a link in the card.

avatar.description: Attachment id of the profile photo; clients show initials when absent.

last_active_ms.description: Never present when the user has chosen to hide it (SV-12).

last_active_real_ms.description: Always the real value for admins, regardless of `hide_last_active`.

phone.description: Work phone number as typed by the person or the admin; free text.

title.description: Job title shown on the profile and in the contacts list ("Head of Product Operations").

AiDefaultsUpdate.description: Which provider serves which feature. An empty string clears the choice (= automatic).

AiOverview.description: All providers plus which one serves which feature. `None` = the first enabled provider with a key.

notice.description: Shown by the admin panel: message text is sent to the provider.

AiProvider.description: One configured AI provider as the admin panel sees it. The API key is never returned.

base_url.description: Overrides the provider's default API address (OpenAI-compatible servers, proxies).

key_hint.description: Last four characters of the key (only when the key is long enough for that to be safe).

kind.description: "anthropic" or "openai" ("openai-compatible" is accepted as an alias).

api_key.description: A new key; `None` or an empty string keeps the stored one.

since_ms.description: Only messages after this time (UTC ms); default the last 24 hours.

answer.description: Also ask the model for a short answer based on the top hits.

meta.description: M-30/M-31: duration, waveform peaks, size and poster frame of voice messages and videos (set by the uploader).

removed.description: True when an admin removed the file; clients show "File removed".

AttachmentMeta.description: Media details the sender's app computes before sending: used to draw waveforms and video posters without downloading the file first. Everything is optional; the server only checks the size and field limits.

pages.description: Page count of a PDF or slide deck ("4.2 MB - 28 pages" on document cards).

peaks.description: Loudness per slice of the recording, 0..=255, 64 values at most.

poster_b64.description: A small JPEG of the first video frame, base64 (at most about 40 KB).

AvatarOverride.description: A private picture the caller chose for another user (`kind` = "user") or a conversation (`kind` = "conv"). Only the caller ever receives it; it wins over the person's or channel's own picture on the caller's devices.

encrypted.description: True when the backup file is encrypted with the backup passphrase (age).

BackupSettings.description: Where and how often full backups run. The passphrase is never returned.

retention.description: How many full backups to keep; older ones are deleted from the target.

clear_target.description: Use the attachment storage as the target again.

passphrase.description: Set or change the encryption passphrase (min. 8 characters).

Bookmark.description: A channel bookmark (C-07): a link or a file shortcut shown above the timeline.

activity_read_ms.description: Activity items at or before this time are read.

avatar_overrides.description: The caller's private pictures for other users and conversations.

cursor.description: Start `events` / the WebSocket from this cursor after applying the snapshot.

has_more.description: Per conversation: true when older messages exist on the server.

messages.description: Latest messages per conversation (conversation id -> ascending by seq).

org_settings.description: The organisation settings (who can create channels, who can pin in channels).

prefs.description: Per-conversation favourites, sections, mute and notification level (NV-01..NV-07, N-03).

saved.description: Saved messages ("Later") and the user's labels.

threads.description: Threads the user follows, newest activity first (M-06, M-07).

BotProfile.description: What members see on a bot's profile (A-04).

ChannelPins.description: Who may pin messages in channels (DMs and group DMs: always every member).

oneOf.description: Every member of the channel.
Channel managers (conversation role `owner`) and admins only.

ClientWsMsg.description: Messages from client to server. The first message must be `hello`.

oneOf.description: Presence preference changes are made via PATCH /me; this reports idle state (auto-away).
The client has applied all events up to and including `cursor` (drives delivery state).
v1.1 stub: call signalling is not implemented in v1.0.

ConvPref.description: Per-user state of one conversation (synced across devices).

mute_until_ms.description: Muted until this time (UTC ms); `-1` means forever. Absent: not muted.

position.description: NV-04: the user's own order inside the section (lower first). Absent: not reordered, sorted by the list setting.

mute_until_ms.description: `0` unmutes, `-1` mutes forever, otherwise mute until that time.

section_id.description: Empty string removes the conversation from its section.

oneOf.description: Notes to self.
A channel: always private. People are in it only because an owner, admin or manager added them.

ConversationSummary.description: A conversation plus the calling user's own state in it.

avatar.description: The picture of a channel or group DM that everyone sees (an attachment id with purpose `avatar`).

last_seq.description: Highest message sequence number in this conversation.

Counts.description: `GET /me/counts`: the numbers behind the filter pills (All / DMs / Channels / Threads / Files). Cheap to compute; clients refresh it on start and whenever a `thread_update`, `conversation_upsert` or `message_new` event arrives.

conversations.description: Conversations you are in, excluding archived ones and notes to self.

files.description: Files in your conversations (not removed, not deleted messages).

threads_unread.description: Threads with replies you have not read.

unread_conversations.description: Conversations with unread messages or marked unread.

unread_messages.description: Unread messages across all conversations (thread replies included).

conv_ids.description: Conversations (channels / group DMs) to add the bot to straight away.

CreateConversation.description: `POST /conversations`. Creating a `channel` is open to everyone unless the organisation setting `channel_creation` is `admins`; creating a `group_dm` is always open to everyone. The creator joins as a member with the conversation role `owner` (channel manager).

include_creator.description: Admins only: set `false` to create the conversation without joining it (the admin panel does this). Default true.

members.description: The other people to add (the creator is added automatically).

create_login_link.description: Also create a one-time login link (default true when no password is given).

password.description: Leave empty to create the account with a random password and a one-time login link only.

also_other_copies.description: Also hide the messages for every other member (default false: their copy stays).

before_ms.description: "Delete before date": every message strictly older than this time.

from_ms.description: Start of the range (inclusive). Omit together with `before_ms` semantics for "everything before".

to_ms.description: End of the range (inclusive). Ignored when `before_ms` is set.

DraftItem.description: A draft, per conversation or per thread (M-22). An empty body means "no draft".

ErrorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable error codes. New codes may be added; existing ones never change meaning.

oneOf.description: Missing or malformed credentials.
Access token expired; refresh and retry.
The device session was revoked; the client must wipe local data.
The account was disabled; the client must wipe local data.
An admin reset the password; the client must wipe local data and sign in again.
An admin cleared this user's history; the client must wipe local data and sign in again.
Too many failed sign-ins; try again later.
Edit refused by the edit rule (a reply has been received in a DM / group DM).
The client's event cursor is older than the retained log; re-bootstrap.
Client older than `min_client_version`.
First-run setup has not been completed yet.
A required backup could not be written, the action was refused and nothing changed.

Event.description: One entry of a user's ordered event log. `cursor` increases monotonically per user.

oneOf.description: Edit applied; `message` carries the new body and version.
Tombstone (the sender deleted the message, or an admin deleted it for everyone).

The messages vanish from this user's view only: "Delete for me" (`POST /messages/{id}/hide`, sent to all of that user's devices) and admin clear-history / date-range delete. Drop them from the cache and the lists.
Removed from the conversation, or it was deleted.
Someone else read up to `last_read_seq` in a DM or group DM (read receipts); sent only when that person has them on.
An admin removed a file; the attachment shows "File removed".
Own profile / settings changed on another device.
A followed thread changed (new reply, follow/unfollow, read). `following=false` removes it.
Favourite / section / mute / notification level changed on another device.
A private picture for another user or a conversation was set (`attachment` = Some) or removed (None). Sent only to the person who chose it.
A scheduled message was created, sent, cancelled or failed (SV-10).
A message was saved for later or its labels changed.
Activity was marked read (on any device).
The organisation settings changed (sent to everyone).
The server restored data for this user; discard the cache and bootstrap again.

cursor.description: Cursor to continue from (the last returned event, or the request cursor if none).

FileHit.description: A file in the Files browser / file search (F-05, SR-03).

Form.description: A JSON form a bot attaches to a message. Rendered natively as a card (or a modal when a button carries its own form); the response goes back to the bot.

submit_label.description: Label of the submit button shown when the form has fields (default "Submit").

form.description: A button can open a modal form (A-03); the response is sent with this button id.

default.description: String for text/select, bool for boolean, array of strings for multi_select.

button_id.description: The pressed button; absent for the plain submit button of a form with fields.

comment.description: Optional note posted with the forwarded message.

FreshRestoreRequest.description: Restore of a full backup onto a fresh (empty) server.

key.description: Object key of the backup; default: the most recent one.

target.description: Where the backups are kept; omit when `upload` is used.

attachments_resolvable.description: Attachments found in the connected storage after the restore.

HideMessageResponse.description: `POST /messages/{id}/hide` ("Delete for me"): the message is hidden for the caller only, on all their devices.

path.description: Path that accepts `POST {"text": "..."}` (relative to the server address).

Label.description: A label the user created for organising saved messages. Private to the user.

LinkLoginRequest.description: Sign in with the one-time token from an admin-created login link.

link.description: Paste this whole link (or just the token) on the app's login page.

password_set.description: False for accounts created with a one-time link that have not set a password yet.

presence_pref.description: What the user chose: "auto" (online while connected), "away" or "dnd".

privacy_controls_enabled.description: True when an admin enabled the Privacy screen for this user (SV-12).

read_receipts.description: Read receipts (default on): when off, other people do not see how far you have read in DMs and group chats.

last_read_seq.description: Read receipts: how far this member has read (conversation sequence number). Only set in `dm` and `group_dm` conversations and only when the member has read receipts switched on. A message of yours is "read" in a DM when the other member's `last_read_seq` >= its `seq`. Kept current by the `read_receipt` event.

role.description: "owner" or "member" (conversation-local role). The conversation `owner` is the channel manager: they can rename, set topic and picture, add and remove members, archive and (always) pin. The creator of a channel or group DM gets it.

also_send_to_channel.description: "Also send to channel": a thread reply (`thread_root` is set) that also shows in the conversation's main timeline. It is one message, not a copy: show it in the timeline as a reply to the thread root (`thread_root`), and in the thread as usual. Absent means false. Always false for messages that are not thread replies.

body.description: Plain text in the small markup (see docs/API.md). Empty for tombstones.

client_id.description: Client-generated id for idempotent sends (only echoed to the sender's devices).

delivered.description: Delivered to at least one recipient device.

form.description: SV-17: interactive form sent by a bot.

forwarded.description: M-20: set when this message was forwarded from another conversation (attribution).

responded.description: Users who already submitted the form.

OrgSettings.description: Organisation-wide settings, `GET /org-settings` (any signed-in user), changed by admins with `PUT /admin/org-settings`. Also part of the bootstrap and kept current by the `org_settings_update` event.

channel_pins.description: Who can pin in channels: `everyone` (default) or `managers`.

conv_id.description: Only events of this conversation; absent means every conversation.

events.description: Event names, e.g. `message.created`; empty means all.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 key used for the `X-WorkChat-Signature` header.

Pin.description: A pinned message (C-09). At most 100 per conversation.

PublicUrlSettings.description: The externally visible base URL used in login links (owner setting; the env var wins when set).

effective.description: What links are built from right now.

url.description: The URL saved in the admin panel (empty when none).

ntfy_url.description: ntfy server URL (falls back to the server's configured one).

target.description: FCM / APNs device token, the ntfy topic, or (kind "unifiedpush") the full endpoint URL the distributor gave the app.

PushSettings.description: Push delivery settings. Secrets are masked in GET responses; send the mask back to keep them.

ntfy_url.description: ntfy server (self-hosted on the compose network, or https://ntfy.sh).

notes.description: Release notes as plain text, trimmed.

RestoreRequest.description: Selective restore from a per-user or full backup (merge by default).

mode.description: "merge" (default) adds what is missing; "replace" makes the user's view match the backup.

user_ids.description: Users to restore; ignored when `all` is true. Empty with `all=false` is an error.

SavedItem.description: A message the user saved for later. The message itself is read from the normal message cache.

SavedMessage.description: One entry of `GET /saved/messages`: everything a "Saved" screen needs to draw a saved message without more requests.

conversation.description: The conversation it is in, with the caller's own state (name, kind, members, unread).

message.description: The full message, with `attachments`, reactions, forward info and so on, as `GET /messages/{id}` returns it.

due_ms.description: UTC ms; must be in the future.

snippet.description: Snippet with matches wrapped in `[[` and `]]`.

channels.description: Channels and group DMs of the caller whose name matches (SR-05).

also_send_to_channel.description: With `thread_root`: also show this reply in the conversation's main timeline ("Also send to channel"). Still one message.

client_id.description: Idempotency key generated by the client; retries never duplicate.

setup_required.description: True until the first owner account has been created.

oneOf.description: Ordered events. `caught_up` is false while the backlog since the client's cursor is still streaming.

SetConvAvatar.description: `PUT /conversations/{id}/avatar`. Owners and admins set the picture everyone in the channel or group sees.

avatar.description: Attachment id of an uploaded image (`purpose=avatar`); an empty string removes the picture.

StorageConfig.description: Attachment storage backend configuration. Only config, accounts and the text database live on the server's disk when a cloud backend is selected.

oneOf.description: Directory on the server disk (testing / small installs).
Any S3 API: AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO.
Google Drive (OAuth refresh token, drive.file scope).

last_reply.description: The newest reply (for the thread preview line); absent while there are no replies.

ThreadView.description: A thread root plus its replies (M-05).

avatar.description: Attachment id of an image the admin uploaded with `purpose=avatar`; empty string clears the bot's picture.

title.description: Job-title line shown under the bot's name (for example "Deploy bot").

privacy_controls_enabled.description: Turns the Privacy screen on for this user (SV-12).

avatar.description: Attachment id of the profile photo; clients show initials when absent.

last_active_ms.description: Never present when the user has chosen to hide it (SV-12).

phone.description: Work phone number as typed by the person or the admin; free text.

title.description: Job title shown on the profile and in the contacts list ("Head of Product Operations").

UserGroup.description: A user group (`@handle`) that expands to member mentions when a message is sent (M-18).

ViewerConversation.description: A conversation as shown in the admin viewer (any conversation, including other people's DMs).

avatar.description: The picture of a channel or group DM that everyone sees (an attachment id with purpose `avatar`).

last_seq.description: Highest message sequence number in this conversation.

title.description: Display title (the other person's name for DMs when viewing as a user).

ViewerHistory.description: Admin viewer: a page of a conversation's messages plus reply counts for the thread badges.

reply_counts.description: Thread root id -> number of replies.

description: Every public type, used only to produce one JSON Schema document with all definitions.
